Languages Proficiency Level

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

languages = ['English', 'Hindi', 'Malayalam', 'Tamil', 'Arabic', 'Japanese']
levels = [5, 5, 5, 5, 2, 2]  # Fluent=5, Basic=2

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.pie(levels, labels=languages, autopct='%1.0f%%', startangle=90)
plt.title('Language Proficiency Distribution')
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

skills = ['Python', 'SQL', 'Excel', 'Power BI', 'R']
proficiency = [8, 7, 9, 8, 6]

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.barh(skills, proficiency, color='steelblue')
plt.xlabel('Proficiency (out of 10)')
plt.title('Technical Skills')
plt.xlim(0, 10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
